'''Di'hal'uma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as an [[Private investigator/Legends|private investigator]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Talons]] swoop gang entered the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], so they hired Di'hal'uma check out the other participating teams. One of the other teams was made up of "Duckonians," a made-up species that the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Mebara Jos]] and other members of the [[Fireclaw Horde]] had disguised themselves as. Di'hal'uma discovered the Duckonians' secret, so she arranged a meeting with [[Seng Windrunner]], the leader of the Talons, to report this to him. However, Jos was aware of Di'hal'uma's investigation, so she arranged for the [[Blood Raptors]] to kidnap the Twi'lek from the [[Dancing Flame Tavern]], on Cularin.<ref name="CaV" />
